responsibility: Defines the lowering visitor for Rust statements and statement-position items. It translates let statements, empty statements, expression statements with and without blocks, and item forms that may appear in block scope into HIR::Stmt nodes, tracking whether a statement terminates control flow and applying item-specific attribute, DefId, and location registration when the lowered statement is also an HIR item. This file is the bridge between expression/item lowerers and block lowering, focused on statement sequencing and block-scope declarations.
